none: PAS LIN-82F9F8: LIN-82F9F8: Roman nummus of Valentinian I
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [D N VALENTINI-AN VS P F AVG] ; R/ [SECV]RIT[AS-REI PVBLICAE]

An incomplete copper-alloy Roman nummus of Valentinian I (A.D. 364-375), dating to the period A.D. 364-367 (Reece Period 19). SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE reverse type, depicting Victory walking left, holding wreath and palm. Mint illegible. Only 70% of the object survives. Obverse description: Pearl-diademed bust of the emperor, right, draped and cuirassed. Obverse inscription: [D N VALENTINI-AN VS P F AVG]. Reverse description: Victory advancing left with wreath and palm. Reverse inscription: [SECV]RIT[AS-REI PVBLICAE]. Diameter: 16.25 mm; Thickness: 1.58 mm; Weight: 1.39g; DA=12
